text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner of 153 Strathallan Boulevard to maintain 1) 3.0 metres high board on board cedar privacy screen 2) 2.1 metres high board on board cedar pool equipment storage unit, which does not meet the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences, as detailed in the following chart. The subject property 153 Strathallan Boulevard is located in Ward 8, in residential zone. LOCATION ORIENTATION DEFICIENCY BY-LAW SECTION* Rear Yard East side of the property Height Height of fence (Pool equipment storage unit) at the highest point is 2.4 metres in the rear yard, exceeds the permitted height of 2 metres.
